observation: A disc carrying a globe on a short seat collar, with a tilted ring standing clear of the globe, one fused body. Front: the ring leans down toward the right and its underside is carried down to the disc on the low side as a thickened web, tapering to nothing on the high side; the disc wall draws inward as it rises. Top: ring and globe concentric with the disc, ring inside the disc diameter. Iso: one body, the ring reads as a real annulus standing clear of the silhouette, no gap and no clash where it meets the globe.
